_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your values. config.json is gitignored.

auth._comment: Azure App Registration with DeviceManagementApps.ReadWrite.All permission

intune._comment: assignmentGroupId: leave empty to skip automatic group assignment

build._comment: psadtVersion must match a tag on https://github.com/PSAppDeployToolkit/PSAppDeployToolkit/releases

github._comment: Optional: Personal Access Token to avoid API rate limiting (60 req/h unauthenticated)

branding._comment: Global PSADT UI branding applied to every package. All fields are optional.
